name: Render: Concept Explorer
description: Declares a two-panel layout with shape-slot placeholders for conceptGraph and relatedConcepts. The layout renders immediately with pending skeletons; the ActivityApiSubscriber fills the slots in-place when the shapes resolve from concept-db. No polling or data pushing required from the activity.

tasks.description: Render the layout skeleton with shape-slot placeholders. The activity does not need the actual data — slots fill themselves reactively.

prompt.template:
Declare the concept explorer layout using render_ui. This layout uses shape-slot primitives as placeholders — do NOT embed data in them.

Concept name: {{conceptName}}

Call render_ui ONCE with:
- primitive.type: container
- primitive.layout: vertical
- primitive.gap: 16
- primitive.padding: 20
- primitive.naked: true
- primitive.children:
  1. A horizontal naked container (gap: 10, align: center) with:
     a. A badge (variant: info, text: 'concept-db')
     b. A text heading: '{{conceptName}}'
  2. A horizontal naked container (gap: 16, wrap: true) with:
     a. A shape-slot node:
        - type: shape-slot
        - shape: conceptGraph
        - label: Concept Graph
        - vessel: concept-db
        - height: 440
     b. A shape-slot node:
        - type: shape-slot
        - shape: relatedConcepts
        - label: Related Concepts
        - vessel: concept-db
        - height: 440
- animation: fade
- position.mode: flow

The shape-slots will pulse with a skeleton animation until concept-db resolves the shapes.

variables.name: conceptName
variables.description: Name of the concept to explore
